knobs.note: Read by bin/gh-pat-charge-alert.sh as ${GH_PAT_CHARGE_ALERT:-1}; 0 stops the lane before it reads the ledger or writes anything.

Read by bin/gh-pat-charge-alert.sh as ${GH_PAT_CHARGE_ALERT_MIN:-1}: the fewest COUNTED calls one box charged to one PAT bucket (pat-* or graphql-pat-*) in the last complete UTC hour before that pair gets its once-a-day ALERTS.log line. 0 or non-numeric falls back to 1.

Read by bin/gh-pat-charge-alert.sh as ${GH_PAT_CHARGE_ALERT_HOUR:-}: the UTC hour (YYYY-MM-DDTHH) to check instead of the last complete one. A re-check / test seam, so NOT settable from the control plane.
